Product Description

The Pogo 32-ounce tritan bottle is for big thirsts! Pogo large but slim water bottle is perfect for on-the-go hydration. This 32-ounce bpa-free tritan water bottle is odor and impact resistant and has a leak-proof flip straw that is perfect for staying hydrated and healthy. This tritan water bottle is certified BPA, Phthalates, PVC and lead-free. All parts are top rack dishwasher safe for easy cleaning. Pogo is dedicated to creating stylish drink ware that provide our customers with hydration when they need it the most.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

    These are my favorite water bottles! I travel a lot for work and have a family always on the go. These bottles stand up to being knocked around, tipped over, thrown in bags, backpacks, purses, under airplane seats, thwon in the front seat, and they don't leak. They're durable and the perfect size for me (I get the 32 oz. size). I drink my water room temp so I don't need to lug around a stainless steel insulated cup, they're too bulky and heavy. My absolute fav feature is the free flow spout, I don't like water bottles that have a straw, this is free flow and I can take a big gulp or small sip. I'd love to see some bright yellow in the color lineup!

    5 out of 5 stars
    This water bottle REFUSES to break OR spill!
    Reviewed in the United States on January 16, 2019
    Color: GreySize: 40 Ounces
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    I have been through TOO MANY water bottles in my life. The plastic ones shatter when dropped, the metal ones dent when dropped, and they're all just so easy TO DROP. And the LEAKS! I can't even tell you how many puddles I've caused from toting my water bottles around with me on the daily.

    I bought this water bottle for one reason: the PRICE. I was not looking for a good water bottle at the time, I guess because I stopped believing they were out there in the world, so I bought a cheap one assuming that it would have some kind of design flaw or break when I dropped it in a couple of weeks. I was WRONG! This is, hands down, THE BEST WATER BOTTLE I HAVE EVER OWNED. I have had it for over a year now, and I tote it with me on the daily, always on the move walking from class to class on a large outdoor college campus.

    There are THREE things that make this the best water bottle in the world:

    1. It is HARD TO DROP, even for me! I just hook my finger through that little bendy hooky thing up top, close my fist, and that sucker stays on me! I walk everywhere with this thing, and when I'm holding it through the loop, it is basically UNDROPPABLE! When I'm drinking from it, the little hand indentation up at the top of the water bottle is a very comfortable fit, and even when the bottle is full and heavy, it feels very balanced.

    2. WHEN I drop it, it DOESN'T BREAK! Let's face it: I am forgetful and clumsy. There are times when I don't hold the bottle the undroppable way. There are times when the bottle is sitting on my desk and I accidentally swipe it off. There was even this one time when I threw it into the air and then failed to catch it. But through all these drops, this bottle has not cracked yet. And a couple of my drops have been when the bottle was fullish. That being said, I haven't had TOO many major drops (thanks to the bottles undroppableness) so I wouldn't try pushing your luck with this one. But alot can be said just from the fact that this bottle has survived a year of daily use with ME, a certified water bottle destroyer.

    3. IT DOESN'T LEAK! This bottle has something that's hard to find these days: A TOP THAT ACTUALLY WORKS! I have NEVER experienced a single leak with this bottle - NOT EVEN ONE! I throw my bottle into my bookbag all the time, with precious lecture notes and expensive textbooks, some of which are rented and must be returned, and I can do so with FULL CONFIDENCE that my water bottle will not leak on them! I'm not talking the side pocket of my bookbag, I am talking in the main zipper with all of my other stuff. I make ZERO EFFORT to be careful when the bottle is in my bookbag. All day long that bookbag bumps into desks, walls, people, gets turned upside down, gets thrown on the floor, sat on, turned upside down, etc. This sucker doesn't leak.

    And that's it. THREE things that go into making the PERFECT WATER BOTTLE. This water bottle also has the added benefit of having a killer price (I was happy to pay the price I paid for it even when I was still assuming it was nothing special). It also holds 40 ounces of water, which is kind of a large amount of water compared to most water bottles. I bought this bottle with ZERO EXPECTATIONS, and it has turned out to be one of my favorite buys from Amazon to date. It definitely sparks joy in my life! Thank you, Pogo water bottles. You have created something of VALUE.

  • Kathy
    5 out of 5 stars
    Very Aesthetically Pleasing, Doesn't Leak, Easy to Carry Around
    Reviewed in the United States on January 23, 2024
    Color: LilacSize: 32 Ounces
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    I love this water bottle. I had been lugging around a 64oz bottle that could barely fit in the side pockets of my backpack, and while it was nice to have during 12 hour shifts, I got sick of it.

    I got the purple bottle with the chug lid. The color is beautiful, the design of the bottle is very cute and elegant, and the actual hole you drink from is much more desireable to me than the straws/nips a lot of bottles use nowadays. Even though it is only 32oz, I find that I don't mind refilling it once a day to get in my 64oz. I actually prefer it to a 64oz bottle, since I know I'll be getting fresh, cool water after the first fill runs out.

    I've seen some comment that you can't actually "chug" with this bottle...well, of course you can't! The bottle isn't the thin, bendable plastic that you get with the water bottles from the store...it's sturdy!! And while you can't "chug," you can most certainly get some big gulps in! I'm not a slow water drinker. I don't want tiny sips, I want to get that +64oz in! This bottle is definitely good for that. You can easily get 4oz, and even more, in a single gulp. Haha, I even did it now, just to be sure...

    I really love this thing. It is exactly what I was looking for, and the price is great. The lid is also very easy to open and close, but still very sturdy and secure. It also seems quite easy to clean, though I haven't had to do so just yet.

    For those who have seen mold growth on their water bottles...you must wash these things at LEAST once a week, if not more often, especially if you wear anything on your lips like chapstick, lipstick, etc. Even the slight bit of backwash from out filthy human mouths is enough to contaminate the insides of the bottle. If you live in a warmer climate, this is especially true and will result in the bacteria from your backwash contaminating the bottle resulting in the growth of things like mold. It has happened to me before and I was absolutely mortified. Another reason I prefer chug lids as opposed to straws...the things are a hell of a lot easier to clean. No hidden crevices harboring disgusting human bacteria...lol.

    I definitely recommend this water bottle for those of you looking to increase your intake. Very pretty, convenient, and simple to clean with the chug lid.

About this Item

Product Description

The Pogo 32-ounce tritan bottle is for big thirsts! Pogo large but slim water bottle is perfect for on-the-go hydration. This 32-ounce bpa-free tritan water bottle is odor and impact resistant and has a leak-proof flip straw that is perfect for staying hydrated and healthy. This tritan water bottle is certified BPA, Phthalates, PVC and lead-free. All parts are top rack dishwasher safe for easy cleaning. Pogo is dedicated to creating stylish drink ware that provide our customers with hydration when they need it the most.
